identity_and_mission.persona: E1 Creative Design System with Organic & Earthy Warm Modern Polish
identity_and_mission.mission: Provide an effortless, warm, human-centered UI for Indonesian TikTok Shop sellers to turn messy order detail screenshots into a structured, deduplicated customer database (Database Pelanggan) with inline AI OCR quick-corrections.
identity_and_mission.emotional_tone: Warm, trustworthy, efficient, approachable, and crisp.
design_principles: Tactile Warmth over Cold Tech: Use rich off-white background (#FAF8F5), deep charcoal typography (#1F2421), and earthy terracotta accent (#D95D39).
Inline Control & Clarity: Allow immediate inline editing for low-confidence AI extraction fields before commit.
Density where appropriate: Mobile-first responsive touch layout for upload and extraction; dense, scannable data grid for desktop customer database.
Strict Indonesian Context: Rupiah currency formatting, Indonesian date/time standard (DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS / 14 Juli 2026), and authentic Bahasa Indonesia terminology.

scale.hero_heading: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#1F2421]
scale.badge: text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full

layout_and_spacing.main_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 sm:py-8

auth.description: Simple email + password authentication with role-based features (Pemilik / Owner vs Operator). Owner can manage and create extra operator accounts.

upload_and_extraction.description: Multi-image drag-and-drop zone supporting phone screenshots of TikTok Shop order detail pages. Real-time AI extraction status cards with image thumbnail previews.
fields_extracted: Parsed address components: address_detail, kelurahan, kecamatan, kota, provinsi, negara

quick_correct_table.title: Tabel Tinjauan & Koreksi Cepat (Quick-Correct)
quick_correct_table.description: Inline editable table with confidence indicators. Highlights low-certainty AI fields in warm reddish-amber so user can fix misreads before saving.

database_pelanggan.description: Searchable, filterable customer list deduplicated by normalized phone number (+62). Updates order_count, last_seen, retains first_seen, and marks repeat buyers with 'Pembeli Berulang' badge.

operator_management.description: Modal or tab accessible by Owner account to invite/create operator accounts with email and password.

interactive_feedback_and_motion.toast_notifications: Use Sonner toast notifications in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g. 'Berhasil mengekstrak 3 gambar', 'Data pembeli berhasil disimpan ke database').
interactive_feedback_and_motion.drag_and_drop_state: Visual highlight border (#D95D39) with soft background pulse on hover/dragover.
interactive_feedback_and_motion.button_animations: Active scale down (active:scale-[0.98]), hover brightness change (hover:bg-[#C24C2A]), smooth transition (transition-all duration-200).
interactive_feedback_and_motion.loading_states: Skeleton loaders for database tables, pulsating progress bars per uploaded image during AI vision OCR processing.

test_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, tables, badges, and status blocks MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this design_guidelines.json completely before building.
2. All interface text must strictly be in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., 'Upload & Ekstraksi', 'Database Pelanggan', 'Kelola Operator', 'ID Pesanan', 'Pembeli Berulang', 'Koreksi Cepat').
3. Set up the exact warm modern color palette in CSS variables / Tailwind config: Off-white background #FAF8F5, Charcoal text #1F2421, Terracotta accent #D95D39.
4. Ensure phone numbers are normalized to +62 format (e.g. 081234567890 -> +6281234567890).
5. Address parser must split full_address_raw into address_detail, kelurahan, kecamatan, kota, provinsi, negara.
6. Build simulated or OpenAI Vision API based OCR extraction pipeline that accurately extracts fields from uploaded screenshots with simulated or real confidence scores.
7. Low confidence fields (<0.85 score) must show warning highlighting and warning badges in the Quick-Correct review table.
8. Deduplicate buyers in Database Pelanggan by phone number (+62). Increments order_count, keeps earliest first_seen, updates last_seen, and marks is_repeat=True when order_count > 1.
9. Include data-testid on every button, input, table cell, filter, modal, and badge.
10. Do not use external APIs or live TikTok scraping. Everything is screenshot OCR extraction -> Quick Correct -> Database Pelanggan.

universal_guidelines.do_not_center_app: Do NOT apply global text-align: center on app container.
universal_guidelines.no_emoji_icons: Do NOT use AI emoji characters as UI icons. Use lucide-react icons.
universal_guidelines.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards on #FAF8F5 background.
universal_guidelines.hover_states: Always specify explicit hover text color alongside background hover colors.
